mechanism_narrative: A sharp drop in housing starts signals a weakening consumer demand cycle that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate signals a weakening labor market that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX returns in triggered periods are not significantly lower than baseline (t-test p > 0.1)

mechanism_narrative: An accelerating rise in industrial production signals a strengthening supply cycle that will produce positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: Rank IC remains below 0.1 over any 1-year rolling window

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate signals a tightening monetary cycle that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite negative signal

mechanism_narrative: A rapid rise in the unemployment rate combined with a drop in payroll employment signals a weakening labor market that will produce negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
